source: literature/shortlist.json plus inspected abstracts and DBLP core verification

cards.title: Mastering diverse control tasks through world models
cards.problem: general world-model-based control across heterogeneous domains
cards.method: recurrent world model with normalization, balancing, transformations, and imagined behavior learning
cards.evidence: the abstract reports a single configuration across more than 150 tasks
cards.limitation_for_this_paper: full control agent and mostly different observation protocols; only the transition-family design is comparable

cards.title: TD-MPC2: Scalable, Robust World Models for Continuous Control
cards.problem: scalable decoder-free latent world models for continuous control
cards.method: implicit latent dynamics and local trajectory optimization; SimNorm is a key representation design
cards.evidence: the abstract reports 104 tasks and a 317M-parameter multitask agent
cards.limitation_for_this_paper: published return is not a supervised state-forecast result; the present study adapts only the transition backbone

cards.title: Transformers are Sample-Efficient World Models
cards.problem: extended imagination accuracy with limited environment data
cards.method: discrete autoencoder plus autoregressive Transformer world model
cards.limitation_for_this_paper: visual tokenization and policy learning are outside the continuous-state prediction protocol

cards.title: Physics guided neural networks for modelling of non-linear dynamics
cards.problem: data inefficiency and sensitivity when learning nonlinear dynamics from data alone
cards.method: inject partially known physics at an intermediate neural layer
cards.evidence: the abstract names five nonlinear-system equations and reports improved accuracy, uncertainty, and convergence
cards.limitation_for_this_paper: does not state branch-specific supervised reliability gating under missing observations and parameter shift

cards.title: Physics-guided Deep Markov Models for learning nonlinear dynamical systems with uncertainty
cards.citation: Mechanical Systems and Signal Processing (2022), DOI 10.1016/j.ymssp.2022.109276
cards.problem: uncertain latent inference and physically unstructured deep state-space representations
cards.method: variational Deep Markov Model whose transition/emission structure incorporates physics-based state-space models
cards.evidence: the abstract reports simulation and experimental nonlinear-system case studies
cards.limitation_for_this_paper: already invalidates a generic physics-plus-uncertainty novelty claim; does not state the proposed supervised relative-error gate

cards.title: GLAM: Global-Local Variation Awareness in Mamba-based World Model
cards.problem: reasoning quality from subtle state variation
cards.method: parallel global and local Mamba modules
cards.evidence: the abstract reports Atari-100k normalized-score comparisons
cards.limitation_for_this_paper: memory architecture rather than calibrated physics/data expert selection

cards.title: Prismatic World Model: Learning Compositional Dynamics for Planning in Hybrid Systems
cards.problem: over-smoothed dynamics across contact and impact modes
cards.method: context-aware mixture of dynamics experts with orthogonalization
cards.evidence: preprint abstract reports continuous-control and humanoid experiments
cards.limitation_for_this_paper: gate identifies latent physical modes, not predicted reliability of known physics and data branches; non-archival in the snapshot

cards.title: HaM-World: Soft-Hamiltonian World Models with Selective Memory for Planning
cards.problem: rollout instability under horizon growth and dynamics shift
cards.method: Hamiltonian latent subspace, residual/control dynamics, and Mamba memory
cards.evidence: preprint abstract reports four DeepMind Control tasks and twelve OOD perturbations
cards.limitation_for_this_paper: Hamiltonian structural prior is not general to all dissipative systems; no supervised physics-versus-data reliability gate; non-archival

cards.title: Certified World Models: Predictability Across Configuration, Horizon, and Resolution
cards.problem: average error does not identify a trustworthy region across configuration, horizon, and resolution
cards.method: equivariance, finite-time Lyapunov spectra, and held-out divergence cross-checks
cards.evidence: preprint abstract reports a 40-dimensional learned model and audits of public non-equivariant world models
cards.limitation_for_this_paper: the certificate centers equivariant structure; the present study instead evaluates empirical robustness to corrupted physical context

cards.title: Differentiable modelling to unify machine learning and physical models for geosciences
cards.problem: integration of data-driven learning with mechanistic models
cards.method: review and conceptual synthesis of differentiable hybrid modeling
cards.limitation_for_this_paper: domain-level synthesis, not a protocol-matched world-model baseline

cards.title: A review of uncertainty quantification in deep learning: Techniques, applications and challenges
cards.problem: uncertainty in deep-learning decisions and predictions
cards.method: review of Bayesian approximations, ensembles, and applications including reinforcement learning
cards.limitation_for_this_paper: does not prescribe a dynamics-specific calibration protocol

cards.title: Uncertainty estimation with deep learning for rainfall-runoff modeling
cards.citation: Hydrology and Earth System Sciences (2022), DOI 10.5194/hess-26-1673-2022
cards.method: mixture-density and Monte-Carlo-dropout baselines with post-hoc analysis
cards.evidence: the abstract reports a standardized uncertainty benchmark
cards.limitation_for_this_paper: forecasting domain without action-conditioned world-model rollouts
